paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: The loss comparison between vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM. SepLLM achieves lower loss different computation costs and different training time consistently.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between training time and loss for two different models. The x-axis is labeled "Training Time (s)" and spans a linear scale from 0 to 250000 seconds, with tick labels at intervals of 50000 seconds. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 2.75 to 2.40. A solid purple line, labeled "Vanilla," begins at a value of approximately 2.747 at the start of the x-axis (0 seconds) and decreases to approximately 2.485 at the end of the x-axis (250000 seconds), with a local minimum of approximately 2.530 at 100000 seconds. A solid red line, labeled "SepLLM," starts at a value of approximately 2.703 at 0 seconds, declines to approximately 2.478 at 250000 seconds, and reaches a local minimum of approximately 2.519 at 100000 seconds.
